text: The health department closed a clinic for two days. The clinic workers requested a review of the decision. The health department may have closed the clinic to punish the workers.

structure.main_topic: The health department’s temporary closure of a clinic and workers’ request for review

central_relations.subject: health department
central_relations.action: may have closed the clinic to punish

structure.narrative_frame: A clinic closure is followed by a review request and a possible allegation of retaliation.
